svg.text: the same map with a modulus coprime to 2
Control: x = n mod 81 = 3⁴ in natural order; same rows, smoothing and levels.
n mod 81 explains 0.01% of the variance of s (n mod 64: 7.0%).
n mod 1000 explains 3.6%, almost all of it from n mod 8 (3.6%): 1000 = 8·125.
n mod 125 alone: 0.01%. The contours here only climb with log2 n.
